mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.date, '%m') as month, SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'income' THEN a.amount ELSE 0 END) as income, SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'expense' THEN a.amount ELSE 0 END) as expense FROM account a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE_FORMAT(a.date, '%Y') = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.date, '%m') ORDER BY month
